scope: opened v0.64 states only; development evidence, not a new external claim

algorithm.query_order: ascending optimistic full-diagnosis expected-cost lower bound, then worst-cost lower bound, then query index
algorithm.expected_lower_bound: candidate immediate expected cost plus, for each impure response child, the minimum immediate expected cost of any separating remaining test
algorithm.worst_lower_bound: candidate response cost plus the minimum maximum response cost among child tests attaining that child's minimum immediate expected cost
algorithm.pruning: only after a full-state-mass incumbent exists; prune if full diagnosis is impossible under the one-step test check, or the lexicographic optimistic lower bound cannot beat the incumbent
algorithm.cost_assumption: positive response costs, as frozen by v0.56 profiles
algorithm.objective: maximise diagnosed mass, minimise expected cost, minimise worst cost, then lowest root query index

claim_boundary: A pass freezes the lower-bound mechanism for independent compiled reproduction and a separate registry-audited fresh external suite. It is not itself external validation, novelty proof, peer review or a world-level claim.
